::: {.entry-meta}
[negative result]{.chip .negative} Entry 33 · milestone M3
:::

We tried to produce native electron-cyclotron (EC) heating and current profiles
from the original ITER reference case. These will eventually supply the
transport sources described in the [Primer](../primer.qmd); terminology is in
the [Glossary](../glossary.qmd).

The owner approved continuation with the proposed original ITER numerical case
and its one-run resource ceiling. The first run started and stopped before
producing scientific output. Its plotting dependency rejected the requested
portrait colour PostScript device. GENRAY's error branch then returned zero,
which would look successful if we checked only the process exit code.

The pilot runner also requires the expected output file. It correctly retained
a failure, with unchanged inputs, immutable binary/input snapshots, stdout,
stderr and partial files. No heating or driven-current profiles were produced.

We traced the failure to a missing device alias in the pinned replacement plotting library.
We added a small explicit patch that maps the alias to the library's existing portrait colour
PostScript driver. GENRAY source and physics inputs remain unchanged. The
correction builds separately, retaining the patch and executed build helper.

A plotting-only Fortran probe now checks the actual interface against both
libraries: [all eight plotting-device checks match their expected outcomes]{.claim}[C-155](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-155){.cid .st-measured}. Successful output has the expected page orientation
and colour; an unknown device still fails. This establishes the device correction,
while a completed GENRAY run and full scientific/plotting comparison remain pending.

At this checkpoint, the original one-run approval is exhausted. A concrete retry
request keeps the same allocation and conservative charging ceiling and awaits
fresh approval. No retry, labels or training occurred at this stage. The
[subsequently authorized retry](34-genray-corrected-numerical-pilot.qmd) completes
the numerical pilot. The current-source and ITER pedestal
boundary contracts remain open, and historical full-suite test statistics are
unchanged. M3 remains in progress.

Technical details → [first EC execution and plotting correction](../technical/surrogates.qmd#genray-first-run).
Decision → [OQ-21](../decisions.qmd#oq-21).
